instruction: Add notes to slides missing them while preserving the existing notes on slide 4.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

rules.original_notes: You should also try to answer!

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding notes to slides while NOT modifying existing notes. Slide 4 (index 3) already has notes: 'You should also try to answer!' which should remain unchanged. Evaluator verifies BOTH requirements: (1) slide 4's notes remain exactly as original, and (2) all other slides have notes added to them. Uses partial credit scoring: 50% for preserving slide 4 notes, 50% for adding notes to other slides.
